newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Livzon details B share rights issue.
newsitem.headline: Livzon details B share rights issue.

text.p: Livzon Pharmaceutical Group Inc said on Friday it would make a three-for-10 rights offer to holders of its foreign currency B shares.
The rights issue, priced at HK$4.39 per share, has been approved by the China Securities Regulatory Commission, the company said in a statement published in the Shenzhen-based Securities Times.
The registration deadline is July 16, and the B shares will go ex-rights on July 14, the statement said.
The firm said it would use the net proceeds of 83 million yuan expected from the issue to expand pharmaceutical production and upgrade technology.
Livzon completed a three-for-10 rights issue, priced at 4.70 yuan per share, for holders of its domestic A shares in April this year, the statement said but gave no further details.

Livzon, based in the coastal city of Zhuhai in southern Guangdong province, posted a net profit of 72.21 million yuan for 1996 against 72.76 million yuan in 1995 based on international accounting standards.
